name: How should I prepare my home before bathroom remodeling begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before bathroom remodeling begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contractors arrive, clear out all personal belongings from medicine cabinets, vanities, and linen closets, and establish a clear staging path through your home. You should also finalize selections for all fixtures, tiles, grout colors, faucets, and hardware to avoid shipping delays during construction. Measure doorways and hallways to ensure bulky items like one-piece tubs or large double vanities can physically enter the room. If this is your home’s only full bathroom, arrange temporary accommodations or set up a backup shower schedule before demolition day.
acceptedAnswer.description: Empty all cabinets, finalize fixture and tile orders in advance, clear a walking path for the crew, and plan alternative bathroom arrangements if it is your home's only bath.
